source.note: Captures the Doubao OutboundTransformer.TransformRequest Metadata -> user_id/request_id promotion behavior. The Go test feeds llm.Request{Model:'ep-20241203072800-8f7f', Messages:[{user,'Hello, world!'}], Metadata:{'user_id':'user123','request_id':'req456'}} and asserts that the unmarshaled Doubao Request body has UserID='user123', RequestID='req456', and Metadata==nil (the llm.Request.Metadata map is consumed and popped from the outbound body). This is the canonical Doubao metadata-pass-through contract. selected_channel, upstream_http and client_http are null because the Go outbound unit test does not exercise those stages.

unified_request._comment: Exact llm.Request literal from the Go test 'request with metadata' fixture: same Model and one user message as chat_completion_basic, plus Metadata={'user_id':'user123','request_id':'req456'}.

outbound_http._comment: From TestOutboundTransformer_TransformRequest case 'request with metadata'. The Go validate callback asserts: doubaoReq.UserID=='user123', doubaoReq.RequestID=='req456', doubaoReq.Metadata==nil. The URL/Auth/Method are the same as the basic chat case (the metadata case reuses the same transformer config). Other body fields (model, messages) survive unchanged.

body_json._comment: Doubao Request body after TransformRequest. The transformer promotes Metadata['user_id'] -> Request.UserID and Metadata['request_id'] -> Request.RequestID, then drops Metadata. Only the asserted fields are populated.
